note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23) and peer_close.go. Section 4 requires normal BGP procedures when a TCP session terminates due to a sent or received NOTIFICATION. handleStructuredState now delegates to onSessionDownPlan, which still short-circuits on wasNotification (rpc.ReasonForbidsRetention(reason)), clears any prior peer state (marking purgeAllPrevious if a prior cycle existed), and returns activated=false with no completion callback. All 6 tagged units verified: TestPeerCloseNamesTheNotificationTheNeighborSent vs TestPeerCloseNamesTheTransportLoss drive a running Peer to distinguish Cease/Event 25 (ReasonNotification) from TCP drop/Event 18 (ReasonTCPFailure); TestRFC4724NotificationCloseRetainsNothing asserts zero dispatched commands while TestRFC4724TransportCloseRetains asserts exact source-scoped retain-routes and mark-stale for ReasonTCPFailure and ReasonLocalClose; TestGRStateManagerNotificationBypass vs TestGRStateManagerRouteRetention contrast state-manager activation. Scope note: sent-NOTIFICATION handling shares sessionCloseFor (covered by untagged TestSessionCloseForCoversEveryCause), unchanged from prior scope.
